Plot VT and NVT totals, model and data together

vt_nvt_plot.Rd

Data = the synthetic carriage sample x(t). VT and NVT go in separate panels (colour is used for the simulations).

Usage

vt_nvt_plot(
  vax_start = 2010,
  prevax_years = 2000:2009,
  samodel,
  xt,
  sims,
  palette = "Dark2",
  vaccine
)

Arguments

vax_start

First vaccine year.

prevax_years

Pre-vaccine years (for the x0 segment).

samodel

The model structure.

xt

Grouped x(t).

sims

A simulation, or a named list of simulations.

palette

RColorBrewer name or viridis option for the simulations.

vaccine

Vaccine serotypes (defines VT vs NVT).

Value

A ggplot.
